_comment: Solid-hurdle jumping curriculum (#286), v2 — pushes toward reliable MULTI-hurdle 0.3-0.5m leaping. Warm-started from the v1 jump net, it re-confirms the run (mean_reward), then a CHAIN stage (many moderate hurdles) forces clear-then-recover-then-clear before ramping height tall->taller->0.5m. Promotes on success_rate = fraction of episodes clearing >=1 hurdle (the reward's per-hurdle clear_bonus drives the actual chaining; the metric just gates progression). Longer windows so each gait consolidates before the height rises.
